message:
feat(seo): bright accent colours + theme/background sync on item pages

- labels, table headers and links on the prerendered block are now accent
  amber instead of grey, matching the catalog cards
- prerendered block moved onto CSS custom properties so it follows the saved
  theme; h1 colour set explicitly because the app stylesheet pins h1-h6 dark
- background presets (grid / dots / gradient / waves) now apply to the static
  block too, via data-bsbg on <html>, with light-theme pattern variants
- App writes data-bsbg alongside the existing bgmode-* class
author: BSS Index Developer
